correctness.rationale: PASS: h_gamma^{-gamma}(s)=s^{-gamma}+1 gives exact iterates. Shared uniforms give mismatch probability at most alpha(a_i-1)(n+1)^(-1-alpha), summable; conditional likelihood chi-square increments are O(n^(-2-alpha)), proving both directions of absolute continuity via L2 uniform integrability, not merely coupling. Count LLN distinguishes divergent exponents; summable regime has positive point mass on every finite-one path. Independent Bernoulli Lindeberg/Kronecker arguments and uniform triangular defect bounds prove the critical gamma_N=1+u/log N Gaussian limit. Checked positive seeds/full support, gamma=1 boundary and strict nonzero probabilities. Independent numeric finite chi-square sums for gamma 0.7,1,2: 0.0887,0.1775,0.6510 (10k terms); experiments are not infinite proof.
